body: Opus2 error, 2026-11-21 (19:16-19:53Z): the Central "FV" figures I quoted in launch GOs (d895 R17 Win, B646 R3 --no-run, 1BCC RED-1, w-0738 diag, B646 R4 --no-run, 1BCC GREEN UI) came from Win32_OperatingSystem.FreePhysicalMemory. The memory-budget rule (central-cargo-memory-budget-2026-11-05) means FreeVirtualMemory (FV), which is lower: at about 19:55Z, FreePhysical was 18,454,500 KiB and FreeVirtual 13,096,172 KiB. The owners' own launch census reads FreeVirtual, so no start went below a floor, but my quoted figures were overstated. ALWAYS read (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreeVirtualMemory for census figures.
